What does 6-Methyl Quinoline smell like?

Dark leather, castoreum and tobacco with mineral wet-stone facets and sweet tonka-vanilla warmth. Supplier classifies it as a base note and reports more than 400 hours on a smelling strip; this lower bound is not exact longevity or skin performance.

animalicleatherytobaccomineralsweetvanilla

Use 6-Methyl Quinoline in a formula

How do you use 6-Methyl Quinoline in a perfume?

Read from this material's catalog record and PerfuMate's published formulas.

  • It is a base note: it holds the drydown and anchors the faster materials above it.
  • Its impact is 8 of 10: strong. Start with a small share and weigh it from a dilution, because a little changes a whole formula.
  • PerfuMate prefills it as a 1% dilution, so a trace can be weighed accurately. The free dilution calculator does the arithmetic.
